patch:
--- a/test/e2e/lib/cluster_env.sh
+++ b/test/e2e/lib/cluster_env.sh
@@ -73,7 +73,16 @@
 UNIT_NAMES=(sandbox-runner@.service sandbox-builder@.service sandbox-runner.slice sandbox-builder.slice)
 declare -a OURS=()
 for u in "${UNIT_NAMES[@]}"; do
-    [ -e "$UNIT_DIR/$u" ] && fail "$UNIT_DIR/$u exists; refusing to clobber"
+    if [ -e "$UNIT_DIR/$u" ]; then
+        case "$u" in
+            sandbox-runner.slice) desc="kuasar sandbox runners" ;;
+            sandbox-builder.slice) desc="kuasar image builders" ;;
+            *) fail "$UNIT_DIR/$u exists; refusing to clobber" ;;
+        esac
+        cmp -s "$UNIT_DIR/$u" <(printf '[Unit]\nDescription=%s\nBefore=slices.target\n\n[Slice]\n' "$desc") || fail "existing slice differs"
+        step "reusing byte-identical existing $u"
+        continue
+    fi
     OURS+=("$UNIT_DIR/$u")
 done
 # Full case IDs and node-local sandbox IDs exceed sun_path under CI's run root.
